{{Quote|Do you know what's going on?''"<br />"''Maybe it's another drill.|KE-829 and [[Unidentified stormtrooper (BT-16)/Legends|his partner]]|audio=KE-829.flac|<ref name="ANH" />}}
'''KE-829''' was the designation of a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] served on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] in the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] leading up to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] where the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] was ultimately destroyed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="ANH" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]<ref name="TCG" /> served in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] and was designated "KE-829." [[Gender/Legends|He]]<ref name="GB" /> was one of the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] stationed on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] in the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] prior to its destruction at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], and was on guard duty near [[Tractor Beam 12/Legends|Tractor Beam 12]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] arrived on the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="ANH" />

When the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] deactivated the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] to allow the ''Millennium Falcon'' to leave [[Docking Bay 327/Legends|Docking Bay 327]], he overheard KE-829 and [[Unidentified stormtrooper (BT-16)/Legends|another trooper]] conversing about the [[BT-16 perimeter droid]]. After accomplishing his objective, Kenobi used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to confuse the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and escape the area. Specifically, Kenobi tricked KE-829 into thinking there was something behind them, eventually attributing it to nothing more than outgassing.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The non-[[canon]] comic [[Tag & Bink Are Dead 1|''Tag & Bink Are Dead'' 1]] retconned these KE-829 and his partner to make them [[Tag Greenly|Tag Greenley]] and [[Bink Otauna/Legends|Bink Otauna]].
